verdict.rationale: Structured output is a fair question for an agent orchestration framework like LangGraph, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions schema-validated output or automatic retries on validation failure. Looping graph workflows are only a developer building block that could be used to build such a retry loop, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get schema-validated structured output from an agent, with automatic retries when validation fails
